exposure: maternal age ranging between 30 and 39 years
cohort: Neonates with birth weight ≥4000 g (cases) and neonates weighing 2500-3999 g (controls)
finding: Fetal macrosomia was associated with several maternal factors and led to increased risks of both maternal and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The study found that the presence of fetal macrosomia risk factors should prompt obstetricians to closely monitor pregnancies and plan appropriate modes of delivery.
